subject: MAP: Exec pricing approval & discount request - NovaHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Thompson <evan.thompson@novahealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft + next steps (target close 2026-04-15)

Thanks again for a great conversation this morning — appreciate the clarity on NovaHealth's priority use cases (patient messaging triage + cost-of-care summaries). Per our agreement on the call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the updated commercial proposal. High-level summary below and proposed milestones so we can align on owners and dependencies.

Milestones (target dates)
- MAP version 1 delivered (you): 2026-03-25 -> INCLUDED (attached: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx)
- Technical deep dive with SE (Redwood): 2026-03-27 -> Owner: David Kim
- SOC2/infosec Q&A & evidence exchange: 2026-03-30 -> Owner: NovaHealth (security) + Redwood (we'll provide write-ups)
- PO/contract review (legal & procurement): 2026-04-06 -> Owner: procurement@novahealth.com
- SSO + Prod connectivity validation: 2026-04-10 -> Owner: NovaHealth IT + David Kim
- Target go-live (pilot): 2026-04-20 -> Target close: 2026-04-15 for contract

Key dependencies
- Procurement sign-off / PO issuance
- SOC2 evidence (Redwood will provide attestation and details)
- Committed spend / pricing level decision (we typically require exec-level approval for discounting beyond standard tiers)

Ask from NovaHealth
- Please review the attached MAP and confirm owners/dates by 2026-03-25.
- Evan/Sofia: confirm procurement timeline and if you'll need a SOW.

Notes on pricing & credits
- Proposal attached reflects our standard enterprise annual pricing. As discussed, any non-standard discounts or onboarding credits will need Exec pricing approval — if you have a specific ask, share details and I'll route it to our Sales Leader for review.

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx, proposal_novahealth_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evan Thompson <evan.thompson@novahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + next steps (target close 2026-04-15)

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear MAP. Evan and I reviewed the milestones and they look reasonable. A couple of items from our side:

1) Pricing ask: leadership is asking whether Redwood can accommodate a non-standard commercial concession to help accelerate the pilot. Specifically, they're requesting a 25% discount off list and $30k in onboarding credits (applied in first 3 months) contingent on a 12-month committed contract.

2) Procurement: we will need a SOW + finalized pricing to route internally. Our target is to have a procurement decision by 2026-04-06, earlier if possible.

Can you escalate the pricing request to your Sales leadership for exec review? If we can get alignment on price/credits this week, we can commit to the timeline.

Thanks — cc'ing procurement.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Director, Digital Transformation | NovaHealth
sofia.ramos@novahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novahealth.com>, Evan Thompson <evan.thompson@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + next steps (pricing concession request) — exec approval request

Michael / Dev — forwarding NovaHealth's pricing ask and MAP (attached). They are requesting: 25% discount + $30k onboarding credits for a 12-month commit. Key context:
- ARR opportunity (expected first-year committed spend) ~ $320k; strategic reference in healthcare; timeline driven by a go-live pilot in April.
- Security/compliance asks are standard; David is lined up to do the technical deep dive on 3/27.

Recommendation: consider a mid-point concession to preserve economics and margin while keeping the deal moving. Suggested options for approval:
A) Approve 20% discount + $15k onboarding credits for a 12-month committed contract (annual minimum $250k) — faster approval likely
B) Approve 25% + $30k credits but require a 24-month committed term and expanded reference/PR commitments

Requested decision: can we confirm an approval path by EOD 2026-03-28? Procurement needs a finalized commercial term to route.

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx, proposal_novahealth_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novahealth.com>, Evan Thompson <evan.thompson@novahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + next steps (pricing concession request) — exec approval request

Marissa — thanks for the clear options and context. Approve option A with the following conditions:
- 20% discount applied to the committed annual spend
- $15k onboarding credits applied in first 60 days
- Customer signs a 12-month committed contract with an annual minimum of $250k
- We require an agreed reference check and a short case study after pilot success (standard PR friendly language)

Dev / Finance: please prepare the updated commercial term sheet and SOW reflecting the above. Ops / Legal, please standby to turn this into a PO-ready SOW once procurement confirms.

Marissa — you have approval; please communicate to the customer and get procurement the updated docs.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai
